lines.en: : I’ve gotta admit, this is not what I was expecting for a first night out with my new amigos, but I am all about it.
: I’ve never been to a maid cafe before so I’m kinda like, fighting off the culture shock right now, I guess.
: Your surname is Imai. Aren’t you half Japanese?
: How can you be so sure that’s my real last name and that I’m not just trying to trick you into thinking I’m amigo material?
: I can’t. I was just asking a question.
: Well, fine! If you’re going to be so pushy about it, yes! I am half Japanese!
: I’ve returned home because I’m actually a princess and I’m here to collect my inheritance.
: Right. So then why are you working as a teacher?
: Where are you from Wakana?
: You really need to stop dodging my questions by asking questions to someone else. It has happened two times already today and I would be lying if I said I wasn’t annoyed.
: I’m from...my apartment.
: Cool cool cool cool cool cool cool. And where did you get that tea? No one’s come to the table yet.
: I texted my significant other and had her prepare it for me beforehand. The walk here was quite cold and I didn’t want to just sit around waiting for tea to brew while freezing to death.
: Non-literal death, of course. I’m contractually obligated to say that now so no one thinks I’m going to kill myself.
: Well, thank you for offering some to us, Wakana.
: Over my non-literally dead body. Get your own.
: So, you come here often, Sensei?
: Are you hitting on me right now?
: Do you want me to be hitting on you right now?
: I don’t not want you to be hitting on me right now.
: Oh, come on. You mean to tell me that one of the like, seven dudes in Kumon-mi is single and doesn’t have anyone who’d get pissed off at him for flirting with some foreign girl?
: I mean, the first part of that is true, but not so much the second. Also, there are a lot more than seven men left in this city.
: Well make sure to have some of ‘em sign up on Tinder at your next super-secret man meeting because I haven’t had anyone to swipe for in ages now.
: And to think that just an hour ago you were accusing the two of us of having a sexual relationship...
: A what now?
: Uhh...Wakana?
Oh, comedic timing. You never let me down.
: Hello, my precious and forgiving kitten with short term memory loss. I love you.
: How are you feeling? Do you need anything? Is the tea good? We’re out of the kind you like, so I had to use one you’ve never had before and-
: I’m fine, my darling. I do not need anything. The tea is nice.
: Awwwwww, my best friend is so cute when she’s in love.
: Best friend? We’ve known each other for roughly one hour.
: And it’s been one of the greatest hours of my life.
: Umm...who might you be, Princess?
: Ha! I told you I was a princess! And you didn’t believe me!
: It’s just what the maids call their female customers. Women are princesses and men are masters.
: Also, you respond to Uta-chan when she speaks to you, damn it.
: Th-Thank you, Master...
: Hey, can we talk in the hall for a minute?
: Hm? Is something wrong?
: Well, not wrong...just...
: Can you just come with me for a second?
: Yes. But I am bringing my tea and you can not stop me.
: That’s fine...
: I’ll be back momentarily, but chances are you won’t even notice I’m gone.
: That’s not another jab at me for never visiting you, is it?
: You won’t even notice I’m gone.
Wakana and Osako step out into the hallway and, in other news, Uta probably thinks I have a tenth girlfriend now or something.
: So, uhh...who are you? I thought I overheard something about Tinder?
: Are you two...you know...
: Know what?
: Please tell me in vivid detail so I can say no and then laugh at you and make you feel embarrassed.
: It’s not a date, Uta-chan.
: Of course it’s not a date, Uta-chan. Sensei would never date anyone ever because he knows it would make me so sad that I might accidentally tie him up and not let him leave home ever again.
: Yeah, I hate when I get sad and accidentally do that.
: Hey, Ami. You’re working late tonight.
: I’m picking up extra hours so I can buy presents for all of my friends since my uncle doesn’t give me an allowance anymore.
: Also, who is this girl and why are you with her?
: This is Imani. She was filling in for Wakana while she was in the hospital.
: That’s right.
: Oh, and I’m also your new student teacher.
: Wait, what?
: Surprise!
: I’ve known since Monday. This just seemed like a good spot to break the news.
: I was holding it in so I could find the best chance to use it for dramatic effect.
: Well, you...certainly picked a time, alright.
Is Imani really going to be a student teacher for my class?
What...exactly is that going to mean for my “methods” of just having everyone do whatever they want all the time?
Don’t tell me she’s going to want me to actually teach now, is she?
: Wait, why are we getting a student teacher? None of the other classes have one.
: You know, it might be hard to believe since you seem like a really smart girl who’s benefited greatly from my new Senpai’s teachings, but the school just thinks he kind of sucks for some reason.
: Hey. That’s not a fair evaluation of my character.
: No, it kind of is.
: Also, Uta is nowhere close to really smart, so I hope your teaching is a little better than your judgement or it will be like nothing’s changed at all.
: Ami-chan, why must you hurt me so? To be called dumb by a fellow dummy makes me feel even...dumber.
: Wait, is dumber even a word? Or is it more dumb?
: Oooookay! So maybe you’re not that smart! But that’s just all the more reason to rely on me!
: But what if we don’t want to rely on you?
: Hm? What do you mean by that?
: What I mean is that our class is kind of...different.
: Sensei has a very...unique way of teaching, and having another teacher around, especially an attractive one,
: Hey, I get it. Change is scary and blah blah blah listen to me, I’m an adult.
: I’m not going to just waltz into class tomorrow and-
: Wait, tomorrow?
: Yeah, I start tomorrow.
: But Wakana doesn’t come back until Monday.
: Well then I guess her students are getting a day off. Can I finish now?
: What I was saying is that I’m not going to just waltz into class tomorrow and change the way you guys have been doing stuff all year.
: I’ll just be around to help anyone who needs it or wants it while, at the same time, keeping Sensei out of trouble.
: What’s Makoto gonna do then? Those are like, all of her favorite things.
: Hopefully, she’ll just die.
: Ami, come on.
: Sensei, I don’t want a student teacher. I want you and only you. Forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and-
: We get it, Ami. You love your [uncle].
: And ever and ever and ever and-
: Man, you get to teach your niece? That’s awesome. I wish I got to teach my family.
: Is your family in Japan too, Princess Imani?
: Nah, they’re still over in Ghana doing Ghana stuff. How about you, Uta-chan? I’d say you look like you come from a big family, but I’ve already been wrong about you once soooo-
Oh, good. Here we go.
: Just my mom and dad and my brother, but my brother is in jail. I had a grandpa too but he died of terminal cancer.
: Man, maid cafes are fucking dope. Where else will people just dump their traumas all over me before I can even order food?
: Honestly? Pretty much everywhere around here. I’m learning that it’s kind of just a thing people do in Kumon-mi.
: You think the brave and adorable Uta-chan would be traumatized by something like watching a loved one slowly fade away into nothingness?
: That seems like a pretty fair thing to be traumatized by, Uta-chan.
: Tsk tsk tsk. Oh, Master. You don’t know the first thing about Uta-chan, do you?
: I know that you lure people into karaoke booths in order to prey upon them.
: Th-th-th-th-that wasn’t Uta-chan! That was normal Uta! And she wasn’t preying on anybody! She just got caught in the moment!
: And ever and ever and ever and-
: I suddenly feel like I’m supposed to be suspicious of something.
: Well, looks to me like somebody must have a pretty lively classroom if these two girls are a sign of things to come.
: Honestly, these two are on the easier side.
: Rude. I'm not easy at all.
: Not like that, Uta-chan.
: Well, hey. I’m up for pretty much whatever. It’s not like I’ve got anything else going on in Kumon-mi anyway.
: I’m looking forward to working with you, Sensei.
: Imani, you’re probably going to question what I mean by this, but I just need you to go along with it when I say that there will be minimal work involved.
: You know, I think I’m starting to figure out why they shoved me in your class instead of somebody else’s.
: I’m sure you’ll confirm that belief on your first full day of class.
: But, in the meantime, we should probably order something since we’ve now been here for...quite a while.
: Oh! Umm...Master? Would it be okay if I pulled you aside for a second? I just had a quick little question for you and stuff.
: Sure, but we should probably try to stay away from wherever Osako and Wakana went. They’ve been gone for a long time and I think they might be making out or something.
I leave the table and Ami immediately begins interrogating Imani about all sorts of topics that I’m sure won’t make her feel strange or unwelcome at all.
That’s not me being sarcastic either. I’ve only known her for a short period of time, but I feel like it’s very hard to throw Imani off of her game.
And while having her around all the time sounds like it could become problematic in a...variety of ways, I’m not going to immediately just write it off.
For all I know, the two of us could get along really well.
Also, she didn’t seem entirely opposed to the threesome idea earlier, and I see that as a huge plus.
: So...what’s up? What did you need to ask me about?
: Well, I...
: I was just wondering if...tomorrow after school...
: You could maybe like...
: Come over?
For entirely unknown reasons, it suddenly becomes harder to stand.
: I will go anywhere for you, Uta-chan.
: Not...for Uta-chan.
: For normal Uta.
: Normal Uta?
: Yeah...
: You...do realize how this sounds, right?
: What if I told you...I already called my parents?
: Well, I’d first confirm that you didn’t tell them who I am or where I live. But after that, I’d-
: Uhh- actually! I forgot to mention that Io is going to be there too. And that...well, she’s the one who wanted me to ask you to come over in the first place.
: I just...went about asking in a really weird way, I guess. Hahaha...
: Yet again, lured into a false state of arousal by a tiny girl in a maid costume.
: So...even if it wasn’t Io and it really was just me...you’d come?
: Is that even a question? Of course.
: I see...
: Why are you being so weird all of a sudden?
: Weird in what way?
: Weird in the fact that you’re not mindlessly flirting with me and that you’re blushing like you’ve been in a sauna for three hours.
: I guess my face does feel a little hot...
: B-But that’s just because I wanted you to think I was embarrassed about asking! I mean, why would I feel nervous about asking you to come over when you’ve been over so many times before?!
: That would be totally weird! And it’s not like I have any intention of letting you put your hands on me or anything!
: Okay, that’s getting back on track. But you still seem a little off and-
: A-Are you coming or not?! Io made you a Christmas present and it’s taking up too much space in our dorm!
: Space? What space?
: That’s exactly the problem! I had to crawl under a table just to get to my skirt this morning!
: Have you considered, you know, storing your clothes somewhere that isn’t directly on the floor?
: Nonsense. The floor is where clothes are supposed to go. If that wasn’t the case, it wouldn’t be so big.
: I’ll make sure to drop by, Uta. Whether or not Io is there.
: Cool...yeah.
: Io will be really happy.
: And you?
: Me?
: Yeah. You’re the one asking. I’m not just dropping by to make Io happy.
: That’s for me to know and you to find out!
: What?
: I...I don’t know!
: I’ll see you tomorrow!
: But...
: We still haven’t ordered...
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
